lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但一直不停。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never stop.
The grass withers where my feet fall.

lines.zh: 每走一步，骨头里响一声。
lines.en: Every step clicks somewhere in my bones.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，所以没有声音。
lines.en: I don't breathe, so I make no sound.
Rotten flesh hangs from my leg and sways.
I follow ten paces behind you.
My shadow runs longer than my body.
Wet clay seems packed into my joints.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，虫都不叫了。
lines.en: Where I pass, even the insects go quiet.

lines.zh: 腐肉拖在脚后，我一步一停。
lines.en: Rot trails behind my heels; I stop at every step.
This undying body never tires of walking.
Black fluid seeps into my footprints.

lines.zh: 我站着，看你把火点起来。
lines.en: I stand and watch you light the fire.

lines.zh: 身体里有东西在慢慢爬。
lines.en: Something inside me is crawling slowly.
I count my heartbeats; there are none.

lines.zh: 皮肤下面鼓起一小块，又平了。
lines.en: A lump rises under my skin, then flattens.
I am not hungry; I am only empty.

lines.zh: 远处有只乌鸦，它不敢落。
lines.en: A crow in the distance dares not land.
I remember that I was once a man.
My memories are paper soaked through.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的胸腔，有回声。
lines.en: Wind passes through my chest and echoes.
I lift my hand and watch it tremble.

lines.zh: 土里有什么在叫我回去。
lines.en: Something in the soil calls me back down.
My shadow moved a moment before I did.
This body is growing, slowly, still.

lines.zh: 我等天黑，天黑了我更快。
lines.en: I wait for nightfall; at night I'm quicker.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see your eyes very clearly.

lines.zh: 活人的热气，我很久没闻了。
lines.en: Living warmth — I have not smelled it in ages.

lines.zh: 别回头，我知道你感觉到了。
lines.en: Don't turn around; I know you feel it.

lines.zh: 你后退时，脚跟撞到了门框。
lines.en: As you back away, your heel knocks the doorframe.

lines.zh: 你走的那条路，我早走过。
lines.en: I already walked the path you're taking.

lines.zh: 你身后那棵树下，我站过。
lines.en: I once stood under that tree behind you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变快了，感染的脉搏也是。
lines.en: Your breath quickens, and so does the infected pulse.

lines.zh: 我认得你眼里的那种怕。
lines.en: I know that fear in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你数过自己的脚步吗？我数了。
lines.en: Have you counted your steps? I have.
Don't smile; the corner of your mouth twitches.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，不动，也不眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at you, still, without blinking.

lines.zh: 火把的光照过来，我的影子却不跟。
lines.en: Your torchlight reaches me, but my shadow will not follow.

lines.zh: 你昨夜听见的声音，是我。
lines.en: That sound you heard last night was me.
You turned around, just in time.

lines.zh: 我看得见你指甲上的泥
lines.en: I can see the dirt under your nails.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我们的视线撞了
lines.en: You look up, and our gazes collide.
Your eyes keep sliding toward the door.

lines.zh: 你身上没有腐味，太新了
lines.en: You carry no rot; you smell too new.
I don't hurt; something simply broke.

lines.zh: 伤口里爬出更小的东西。
lines.en: Smaller things crawl out of my wound.
That cut went in too shallow.

lines.zh: 我的身体在把伤口缝起来。
lines.en: My body is stitching the wound shut.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的手臂，它会再长。
lines.en: You broke my arm; it will grow back.
Black blood pools on the ground.
I sway once, then straighten up.

lines.zh: 被不朽腐尸咬过，也会疼。
lines.en: Even Immortal-bitten flesh can hurt.
Don't stop; hit me once more.
This body holds grudges.
Your warmth smells better than meat.
I'm not hungry, but I want you.
Let me come closer, just a little.

lines.zh: 你的伤口在流血，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your wound is bleeding; I smell it.
Hold out your hand; I won't bite.
That living scent on you is too strong.
I only need one touch, just one.
Don't run; running makes you smell sweeter.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里没口水，只有渴望。
lines.en: My throat has no spit, only craving.

lines.zh: 让我记住你皮肤的温度。
lines.en: Let me remember the warmth of your skin.
Bump into me and you'll feel cold.

lines.zh: 我退开了，你的肩膀还发麻。
lines.en: I stepped back; your shoulder still tingles.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我身上有东西。
lines.en: Don't come so close; something's on me.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的时候，我笑了。
lines.en: When you hit me, I smiled.
My skin feels like wet bark.
That touch left something on you.
We don't dodge; we just collide.
Your armor makes me clatter.
Hit me again; I don't mind.
There's my fingerprint on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 不朽的血，只认自己的种。
lines.en: Immortal blood only knows its own kind.
I don't seek a mate; I seek a vessel.
You're infected too? Come closer.

lines.zh: 我的后代都在土里等着。
lines.en: My offspring are all waiting in the soil.

lines.zh: 这具身体会分裂，不需要爱。
lines.en: This body splits; it needs no love.

lines.zh: 两个感染者，会变成一个。
lines.en: Two infected will become one.

lines.zh: 让我把手放在你胸口上。
lines.en: Let me rest my hand on your chest.

lines.zh: 你若是留下，就再也走不掉。
lines.en: If you stay, you will never leave.

lines.zh: 我不想孤独，我想要同类。
lines.en: I don't want solitude; I want kin.

lines.zh: 他把我造出来时，没问过我。
lines.en: He made me without asking me first.
I pick up the arrowhead you dropped.

lines.zh: 这块布上还有你的味道。
lines.en: This cloth still carries your scent.

lines.zh: 我拾起一根手指，装进口袋。
lines.en: I pick up a finger and pocket it.
That broken blade on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我把石头捡起来，又放下。
lines.en: I pick the stone up, then set it down.

lines.zh: 这枚纽扣是从你衣服上掉的。
lines.en: This button fell from your coat.

lines.zh: 我捡起自己的腐肉，按回去。
lines.en: I pick up my own rotten flesh and press it back.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的火把，我踩灭了。
lines.en: I stamp out the fallen torch.
A feather rots in my palm.

lines.zh: 我收集你们留下的东西。
lines.en: I collect the things you leave behind.
Something living, and the scent is fresh.
Someone is digging over there, loudly.

lines.zh: 我听见了心跳，隔着一堵墙。
lines.en: I hear a heartbeat through the wall.
His back is turned to me, good.

lines.zh: 这个村子的灯，亮得太齐。
lines.en: This village's lamps are too evenly lit.
A quarry is running north.
That cow's breathing has gone ragged.
I see a pair of shoes at the door.
The target moves, and so do I.
People again, always people.
He carries a torch and can't move fast.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那层霜，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the frost crunch under your step.
I smell rust and sweat.
That one trailing at the back.

lines.zh: 有新血味，从北边的坡上来
lines.en: Fresh blood smell, coming up the north slope.

lines.zh: 他点着火把，等于举着招牌
lines.en: He lit a torch, which is a signpost for me.
I hold still; he holds still.
I wait for him to blink first.
I memorize his line of retreat.
He grips his sword far too tightly.
The door behind him is shut.
One step more and he will retreat.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸已经乱了节奏。
lines.en: His breathing has lost its rhythm.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根，等你转过来。
lines.en: I press along the wall, waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 他看不见我站在阴影里。
lines.en: He can't see me standing in the shade.
I want him to run first.
He looks left, where nobody stands.
I hear him swallow hard.

lines.zh: 他会先出手，我看得出来。
lines.en: He'll strike first; I can tell.
Prey always moves first.

lines.zh: 我等他喝完那口水再过去
lines.en: I'll wait for him to finish that sip of water.

lines.zh: 他一伸手，我就知道他怕黑
lines.en: One reach of his hand tells me he fears the dark.

lines.zh: 我不从正面来，绕到左边
lines.en: I don't come head-on; I circle left.
The tree at his back won't keep out the cold.
My hand clamps into his shoulder.
Two nails broke; it doesn't matter.
I bite his neck, and it is cold.
He doesn't shout; he just shoves.
This swipe tears his sleeve open.

lines.zh: 我的指印留在他皮肤上，黑的。
lines.en: My prints stay on his skin, black.
He backs off; I follow him in.

lines.zh: 骨节撞在他肋骨上，响了。
lines.en: My knuckles crack against his ribs.
He should never have let me touch him.
I press him flat against the wall.

lines.zh: 我的手臂比看上去有力。
lines.en: My arms are stronger than they look.
The scratches will darken by and by.
He throws me off; blood drips down.
I laugh without a sound in my throat.

lines.zh: 我按住他的胸口，慢慢压
lines.en: I press his chest and lean in slowly.

lines.zh: 指甲刮过锁甲，声音很钝
lines.en: Nails scrape the mail with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 感染从指尖开始，往上走。
lines.en: The infection starts at my fingertips and climbs.

lines.zh: 我从一具尸体里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a corpse.

lines.zh: 他咬了我，我就成了这样。
lines.en: He bit me, and I became this.
The soil heaves, and I come out.

lines.zh: 不朽的血在我身体里翻。
lines.en: Immortal blood churns inside my body.
This isn't birth; it's contagion.
When I opened my eyes, the sky was grey.
He called me offspring, and I answered.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气是腐臭的。
lines.en: My first breath tasted of rot.
The night pushed me out.

lines.zh: 不朽的腐肉在我骨头上长齐了。
lines.en: Undying flesh has grown neatly over my bones.

lines.zh: 我沿着他的脚印爬起来。
lines.en: I rose following his footprints.

lines.zh: 从死人堆里，我先动的是手。
lines.en: In the pile of dead, my hand moved first.
I have been made again.

lines.zh: 不朽的腐尸咬了我一口
lines.en: One bite from the undead corpse did it.

lines.zh: 我先是抽搐，然后站直了
lines.en: First I convulsed, then I stood straight.

lines.zh: 泥土下面，我换了种活法
lines.en: Under the soil I began a different kind of life.

lines.zh: 血冷下来的时候，我醒了
lines.en: I woke when the blood in me went cold.
Fire licks my skin and raises blisters.
My knee shattered; I crawl regardless.

lines.zh: 水进不去，可我沉下去了。
lines.en: Water can't get in, yet I sink.
The blast tears me into two halves.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在我胸口，我不去拔。
lines.en: The arrowhead lodges in my chest; I leave it there.
Holy light burns my flesh pale.
I never starve; I only hollow out.
Lightning strikes, and I glow for a moment.

lines.zh: 连骨头都烂了，还往下坠。
lines.en: Even my rotted bones keep falling.
